caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical ceramic vessel with a slightly flared rim, two short opposing loop handles near the top, and a gently tapering base. The vessel is primarily a light grey color, with blue painted decorative elements. A thick blue line encircles the vessel near the top below the rim, with a thinner blue line directly above and another near the vessel’s base. The body of the vessel features a large blue floral or foliate motif, composed of curling lines and a central shell-like design on the front. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a detailed inset showing a close-up of one of the handles and a portion of the decorative blue motif. The drawing is bordered by a fine line, and the name “JANET RIZA” is printed in the lower right corner of the bordered area.
title: Jar
